claims.claim: AUTHOR_TASK validates the final TASK directly and reaches mutation without Decision Packet composition, stage validation, audit fingerprints, ledger validation or audited freshness reconstruction.
AUTHOR_TASK rejects supplied audited_handoff material in parsing and execution; the parser also rejects an explicitly supplied null field.
Direct contract, identity/revision, verification-policy, affinity, expected-main, unrelated-delta and compare-and-swap guards remain in the AUTHOR_TASK mutation path.
Origin-proof admission and rechecks retain exact carrier-attempt, TASK, main, route/generation and envelope bindings, HMAC, freshness, replay protections and legacy/revision separation.
AUTHOR_REMEDIATION and AUTHOR_REPAIR retain audited-handoff validation, canonical reconstruction, lineage and freshness enforcement.
The three normative documents state the post-BO-1 direct AUTHOR_TASK rule, preserve mandatory two-stage Brain semantic audit and explicitly mark historical H1/H3 TASK mutation gates superseded.
Focused regressions cover handoff-free TASK authoring, handoff rejection, direct safety and provenance failures, concurrency, and retained correction handoff and freshness enforcement.
